_note: The Frostgruft's puzzle pieces (src/world_kit/frost_puzzles.gd), placed in the Weltbauer. ice: thin ice holds `holds` steps (2 or 1); left for the last time it breaks into a hole, a fall puts the hero back where he last stood on firm ground before the ice and mends every unsolved ice of the room, hurt says whether the fall also costs life. push: the hero leans into a block or a snowball for `hold` s to move it; an ice block slides `slide` cells per second until something stops it and fills a crevasse (pit), a snowball rolls one cell per push at `roll` cells per second, grows by one on deep snow up to `max_size` and fills a crevasse from `fill_size` on (a smaller one falls in and is lost until the rune resets it). ember: an ember taken from an Glutherd or a burning bowl lasts `steps` cells, a cell of cold fog costs `fog_cost`. ghost: the mirror ghost steps the hero's steps mirrored left-right; after `hint_after` s in the room the mirror's lever wakes and shows the way once per pull, a step of the show takes `show_step` s; in its room the camera zooms out to `zoom` (moving `zoom_speed` per second) and looks between hero and ghost, so both fields stay on screen; the ghost is the hero's own figure, mirrored, at `alpha` and tinted `tint`. bells: the crystals sound the notes (semitones over `base_hz`) of their number, the statue sings its melody with `gap` s between notes; crystals: per note (1 first) its colour name and colour (pictures made from the ice spire by tools/frost_dungeon/make_bell_crystals.gd); `voice` shapes the synthesized bell (partials as [ratio, loudness], `decay` per second). beam: the colours of the aurora light. reach: how near the hero must be to use a piece.
